title: EXP-097 - Hello World Part 6 Section 5: Create FX_OrdersChart (Classic Grid Only Wizard on the FX_Orders IDO), Initial Command Refresh with One Designer Save, Runtime Open Check
objective: Follow hello-world-pt6.md Section 5 (04:25-05:33), adapted to FX_ names and User scope: in the Web Designer close FX_Orders, start New Form Definition once, choose Category Classic and Wizard Grid Only, name the Form FX_OrdersChart with the FX_Orders IDO as its data source, accept the wizard defaults (Save Template unchecked) and Finish once. Verify the new Form after one Designer close/reopen. Then set the Form's Behavior > Initial Command to Refresh, perform exactly one Designer Save and verify it after one more close/reopen. Finally open FX_OrdersChart once in the Web Client and record whether both orders appear without pressing F4. The grid is not resized or moved (that belongs with the chart in Section 6). Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Before browser interaction read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt6.md Section 5 and its transcript lines (04:25-05:33), recipes/forms/create-basic-form.md (wizard steps and pitfalls), recipes/session/session-expiry-and-stale-designer.md, and only the final Outcome (operator) sections of the EXP-082 and EXP-096 records. Do not read those records in full.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-097-hello-world-part-6-section-5-fx-orderschart-grid-only-form.md and evidence/EXP-097/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task; never sign in inside the portal's embedded app frame (refused, EXP-080-R2) but use the procedure's top-level portal navigation. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt, menu or unsaved runtime change open across tasks. After any pause, inspect the state read-only before acting and never replay an earlier action.

Designer gate (read-only): the Designer is in User scope; if FX_Orders is open it is clean (Save and Undo disabled). If it is dirty, or the session shows the server-event error, record it and stop blocked.

Close FX_Orders: close the clean FX_Orders Designer Form once through its Form-tab control (fresh snapshot immediately before the click); record any prompt; if a save prompt appears, answer No once and record its exact text. The Designer shows no Form open.

Wizard: click the Designer toolbar New (New Form Definition) once. In Form Wizard Selection choose New Form, Category Classic and Wizard Grid Only, recording every option and description shown, then OK. On each wizard page record every field with its exact label and default value before changing anything, with a screenshot. Enter Name FX_OrdersChart, choose the FX_Orders IDO as the data source (from its list; type the exact name only if no list is offered), leave every other field at its default, and use Next as each page requires. If any prompt says a Form named FX_OrdersChart already exists or offers to replace a Form, answer it with Cancel or No once (never OK or Yes), record its exact text, cancel the wizard once (answer No to any discard prompt) and stop blocked. On the final page uncheck Save Template if it is checked, then Finish once. Record the completion message verbatim and acknowledge it once. At most one correction per field.

After Finish (read-only): record the Designer state: the Form tab FX_OrdersChart, Properties Name, Form Type, Version and scope (status bar), Save and Undo state, the Details > Collections entry (IDO FX_Orders) and the Details > Components inventory (name, type, binding for every row), with screenshots. If Save is enabled after Finish, record it and stop blocked for the coordinator without saving.

Persistence 1: close the clean FX_OrdersChart Designer Form once through its Form-tab control (take a fresh snapshot immediately before the click and use only its references; record any prompt; if a save prompt appears, answer No once and record its text) and reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry; verify User scope and Save disabled; read back Name, Form Type, the Collections entry, the component count and Behavior > Initial Command (expected blank).

Initial Command: with the Form selected in Properties, open Behavior > Initial Command once and choose Refresh from its drop-down (type it only if it is not listed; record the option list), commit it and read it back with a screenshot. Change no other property. At most one correction.

Perform exactly one Designer Save through the native toolbar Save and record its native response verbatim (toast, dialog or error) with a screenshot. If an error appears, record it and stop blocked; never retry the Save.

Persistence 2: close the clean FX_OrdersChart Designer Form once through its Form-tab control (take a fresh snapshot immediately before the click and use only its references; record any prompt; if a save prompt appears, answer No once and record its text) and reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry; verify User scope and Save disabled; read back Initial Command (expected Refresh), the Collections entry and the component count. If Save is enabled after the readback, close once answering No and reopen once to restore clean; if it is still enabled, record it and stop blocked.

Runtime open check (read-only): in the Web Client open Form > Open > Select Form once. If its filter is prefilled, clear it and type FX_OrdersChart once; select the exact FX_OrdersChart row and open it by double-clicking that row (never OK with no row selected, never another row). Without pressing F4 or any query key, record the mode, the grid columns and every row shown, with a screenshot. Expected: order 1: Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Item dumbbell, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00 and order 2: Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Item eggs, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99 shown without F4 (Initial Command Refresh). Record whatever is shown as observed only. Change no value. Close the runtime FX_OrdersChart Form once (clean); if any prompt appears answer No once and record its exact text.

Capture screenshots of the Designer gate, Form Wizard Selection, every wizard page before and after filling, the completion message, the new Form in the Designer with the Components inventory, each persistence readback, the Initial Command option list and readback, the Save response, the Select Form dialog with the FX_OrdersChart row and the runtime Form. Use a distinct filename for every capture; never overwrite an earlier screenshot.

Before every click, use references from the most recent snapshot taken in the current task; after any timeout or 'Ref not found', take one fresh untargeted snapshot and use only its references. Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.

acceptance_checks.description: Sources reviewed; session usable; Designer in User scope; FX_Orders closed clean (no prompt, or No answered with its text). Evidence: gate and closed-Designer screenshots.

One wizard run: Form Wizard Selection with Classic / Grid Only recorded; every page recorded before filling; Name FX_OrdersChart and data source FX_Orders IDO entered; other defaults kept; Save Template unchecked; Finish once with the completion message verbatim; no replace prompt answered OK. After Finish the Designer shows FX_OrdersChart in User scope with its Collections entry and Components inventory recorded. Evidence: wizard, completion and new-Form screenshots.
After one close/reopen, FX_OrdersChart reads back (Name, Form Type, Collections entry FX_Orders, component count; Initial Command blank) with Save disabled. Evidence: persistence-1 screenshots.

Initial Command = Refresh set and read back (at most one correction); exactly one Designer Save with its native response recorded; after one more close/reopen Initial Command reads Refresh and Save is disabled; the Designer clean at the end. Evidence: Initial Command, Save and persistence-2 screenshots.

Runtime: FX_OrdersChart opened once from Select Form (exact row); without F4 the mode, grid columns and rows recorded (expected both orders); no value changed; closed clean. Evidence: Select Form and runtime screenshots.

No change to FX_Orders or another Form, no second wizard, no template, no other property or component change, no Chart component, no runtime Save or F4, no unload, no checkout action, no Yes answer. The final EXP-097 report gives decisive evidence for AC-1 to AC-5, the complete action audit with exact counts (wizard openings 1, Finish 1, field entries and corrections, Designer Saves 1, close/reopen pairs, runtime opens and closes, prompts with texts, errors, re-login count), the worker-written-file inventory and the final state. Repository confinement is supported by worker/harness inventories, with operator git review authoritative. Findings are observed only.

notes: Proposed by the operator assistant after EXP-096 (Part 6 sections 1-4 complete); the operator said yes on 2026-10-15. Tenant mapping: tutorial form Orders Chart -> FX_OrdersChart; Orders IDO -> FX_Orders. Section 5's two changes (wizard creation, Initial Command Refresh) get separate persistence readbacks as the tutorial caution advises. EXP-082 lessons: the Classic wizard checks the name on Next and can offer to replace an existing Form (here always Cancel/No, never replace); Save Template is checked on the final page and must be unchecked; Finish persists the Form and left the Designer clean. The grid resize (step 7) is deferred to Section 6, where the chart needs the space. exact_values: FX_OrdersChart, FX_Orders, Classic, Grid Only, Refresh, FX001, FX002. deny_browser_javascript.
